audit_rule: Main is authoritative. Historical assets are replayed only if they are not already the same theorem, an equivalent coordinate form, a corollary, or a strict specialization of canonical P023 results.

EnterpriseMath/State/OperationCongruence.basis: Extends unary/family descent to one arbitrary finite-arity k-ary operation, proves descended-operation uniqueness under surjectivity, and gives a binary coordinatewise compatibility criterion.

EnterpriseMath/State/ContextSeparation.l.basis: SameThrough over a finite alphabet of unary translations is the relation-level form of P023-T13 finite operation-word semantics; equivalence-relation and triangle consequences are derived structure.
EnterpriseMath/State/ContextSeparation.l.action: CONSUME_P023_T13; replay Lean support only if it removes a formalization gap, not as a second mother theorem

EnterpriseMath/State/TransportProtocol.l.basis: Introduces an explicit access model: decoder knows the coarse input tuple and receives one token from the fine tuple; proves token lower-bound separation and the one-symbol iff compatibility boundary.

EnterpriseMath/State/ReusableInterface.l.basis: Reusable interface = raw observation factors through the interface plus operation-compatible kernel. Operation descent follows from k-ary congruence; minimum reusable state is already governed by P023-T14/coarsest compatible quotient.
EnterpriseMath/State/ReusableInterface.l.action: DO_NOT_CREATE_DUPLICATE_MINIMALITY_THEOREM; retain interface vocabulary only if useful

keep_if_general: coarsest compatible refinement and minimal repair
strict k-ary descent generalization beyond current main
access-model transport protocol results not already implied by quotient closure
forbid: treating ContextSeparation as a separate mother theory from P023 operation-word semantics
reproving minimum reusable quotient separately from P023-T14
promoting application-specific quotient coordinates as universal precision laws
wholesale merging historical branches into the core owner
